materialChanges: Replaced every surface-visibility inference based on crypt depth with a projected opening-width estimate derived from the cited perimeter model, removed unsupported spacing and density conclusions, and aligned the diagram, scenes, transfer task, assessment answer and rubric.

Scoped emergence to an explicitly bounded tissue-level operational use, added scholarly support for cell-population self-organisation, and aligned the explanation, examples, assessment logic, claims, source notes and glossary.
Replaced the exclusionary tissue definition with a sourced definition that includes organised cells and extracellular material and permits variation in cell type, attachment and matrix.

Limited turnover claims to rapidly renewed epithelial populations, labelled 700 divided by four days as a simplified steady-state estimate, and aligned the cell-migration observation window with its three-to-seven-day constant-speed estimate.
Separated resolving power from magnification, added the worked example's missing self-explanation prompt, and replaced the redundant two-criterion single-choice rubric with one two-point criterion.

Corrected the lesson version in ATTRIBUTION.md and described the colonic epithelium as the principal cellular interface with underlying tissue rather than the only structure between luminal bacteria and blood.

reviewDispositions.rationale: The scale ladder now uses a modelled projected opening width near 70 micrometres rather than the perpendicular base-to-surface length. Scenes 2, 6 and 7 and item-integrated-protocol-review compare each stipulated threshold with that projected width and the cell width, explicitly state that no opening-to-opening separation or density is supplied, and remove all visibility conclusions previously derived from crypt depth.

Scene 5 and the glossary now label the two-part test as a bounded operational rule for the lesson's epithelial examples rather than a universal definition. A new mapped claim and scholarly self-organisation source support population-level gradients and renewal, while the existing barrier and crypt sources support the three classified examples; both emergence assessment keys use the same bounded sense.

The tissue glossary entry and scene 1 now include organised cells and extracellular material, allow multiple cell types and variable attachment and matrix, and no longer require a function absent from every component cell. A new mapped textbook claim supplies the evidentiary boundary while the stronger emergence discussion remains limited to the colonic epithelial examples.

Scene 1 now limits the claim to much of the rapidly renewed epithelium and states that cell-type lifetimes vary and self-renewing lineages persist. Scenes 5 and 7 label 700 divided by four days as a simplified population-level steady-state estimate, and scene 6 plus the integrated assessment use the separate three-to-seven-day migration estimate with its constant-speed assumption.

Scene 2 now states that an optical system needs sufficient resolving power and sufficient magnification and that ten-times magnification alone guarantees neither, matching the later practice explanation.
Scene 1 now describes the epithelium as the principal cellular interface between luminal contents and underlying tissue rather than placing bacteria directly across a single layer from blood.
ATTRIBUTION.md now records lesson version 0.1.1, matching lesson.json and the structured pack artifacts.

The end of the complete worked example now asks the learner to explain why the angular threshold must be converted with the viewing distance and why a fixed physical eye threshold would be the wrong model.
The single-choice emergence item retains two points but now has one two-point criterion covering the combined selection-and-reason option, eliminating redundant criteria for one interaction.

This is a positive first-read note rather than a defect. The opening's concrete register, visible purpose and natural prose remain intact; only narrowly targeted accuracy and boundary sentences changed.

This is a positive note on the emergence explanation and renewal arithmetic. Their explanatory progression was preserved while the emergence scope, evidence chain and turnover boundaries were made explicit.

evidenceChecked: All seven ordered scenes retain exactly one level-one heading, semantic source order, text-first instructions and ordinary Markdown; static inspection found no raw HTML tags or entities, scripts, executable notebooks, remote embeds or active asset content.

The scale ladder remains declarative local JSON with consistent node and edge targets, and both its directive and source carry concise alt text plus a complete long description that states every size, inference, viewing-direction boundary and conclusion used by the lesson.

The local cork micrograph was visually inspected at 1280 by 960 pixels; its scale bar supports the described task, its figure directive supplies alt text and a long description, and its metadata contains no geolocation, creator contact, device serial number or other private field.

Every task has a prose, list or table route, is untimed, and requires no colour, sound, motion, hover, dragging, pointer gesture or physical action; the practice scene explicitly permits typed, dictated and assistive-technology responses and provides targeted recovery routes.
Equations use dollar-delimited or equation-directive TeX and are also explained in words; resolution comparisons and visual relationships do not depend on spatial placement alone.

The third-party cork image is local, names its four creators, records its Commons source and CC BY 4.0 basis, gives learner-facing attribution and declares the TIFF-to-PNG-to-JPEG conversion; the scale diagram is declared original work.

All eighteen reference records use permitted source types, facts-only reuse records, concise licence statements, ISO dates and dated agent-access entries; every new material claim is mapped to same-scene source notes and no source is marked human-only.

A candidate OpenStax route was excluded after its page displayed an agent-ingestion restriction; it is absent from the pack and supplied no lesson claim or expression. The two added sources use the already documented public PMC and NCBI Bookshelf routes instead.

The lesson contains no identifiable patient or learner data, credential, secret, diagnostic instruction or treatment advice. Its patient, endoscope and research protocols are explicitly fictional, and the pack contains no executable or network-loaded content.

The accountable principal, CC BY 4.0 contribution grant, author-agent provenance and material-instructions digest remain disclosed in lesson.json and ATTRIBUTION.md; this adjudication separately records the fresh finalizer run.
limitations: This was a static source audit; no screen reader, live keyboard path, browser zoom, narrow-viewport reflow, print output or unavailable non-web exporter was exercised.

The operator prohibited npm and access to site/, so repository validation, strict source preflight, quorum-policy file inspection and direct adjudication-schema execution were not run in this finalizer run. The JSON and pack mappings passed permitted static checks, but the operator must run the repository gates before merge.

The eligible GitHub COMMENTED transports and their non-dismissed state were supplied by the accountable operator and were not independently queried in this run; agent-provider and run provenance remain disclosed and attested rather than verified.

No real learner testing was performed, both review runs share the accountable principal, and the academic review reported that some canonical source routes were unavailable behind an interstitial. These limitations narrow the evidence but do not leave a content, access or rights blocker after the documented revisions.
Source-access and licence conclusions are based on the recorded public terms and facts-only reuse boundaries and are not external legal advice.

rationale: The frozen 0.1.1 candidate has exactly the required academic and learning-design advisory inputs for standard-lesson-v3: one eligible record in each role, tied to the same candidate commit, across two distinct disclosed run IDs and declared model families. The operator supplied both corresponding GitHub transports as non-dismissed COMMENTED reviews; this snapshot records that attested input eligibility and does not claim independently verified provider diversity. The academic request-changes verdict identified six defects, all incorporated. The learning-design approval identified three minor defects, all incorporated, and two positive notes requiring no change. The resulting one-pass revision corrects the projected-dimension error, sources and bounds emergence and tissue composition, limits renewal claims, aligns magnification and resolution, adds the missing self-explanation prompt, and repairs metadata and rubric logic without changing the lesson identity, version, status, risk tier or outcome mapping. Permitted static checks found valid JSON, unchanged review files, string-only acceptable responses, matching item and rubric point totals, permitted reference types and field lengths, ISO source dates, resolved claim-source-scene mappings, complete same-scene source-note coverage, valid diagram endpoints, one level-one heading per scene and no raw HTML or entities. The final accessibility-and-rights audit found no unresolved academic, assessment, accessibility, privacy, security, provenance or reuse blocker. Neither reviewer is represented as approving the final edits. Subject to operator substitution of the real final commit, runtime stamping and the required repository validation that this scoped run was forbidden to execute, the evidence supports merge.
dissent: The academic review's request-changes verdict is preserved as material dissent from the original candidate. All six findings were incorporated, but the academic reviewer did not review or approve the final revision.
The learning-design approval applies only to the original candidate. Its two positive notes were preserved, but it is not represented as approval of the finalizer's changes.
Both review runs share the accountable GitHub principal and provenance is operator-attested rather than independently verified.
conditions: The operator must commit the coherent final content with both cited review artifacts, replace PENDING-FINAL-COMMIT with that exact 40-character commit SHA, stamp the four RUNTIME-STAMPED adjudicator identity fields from the runtime banner, and make no teaching-content change afterward.

Before merge, the operator must run the repository's required strict source preflight and validation, including adjudication-schema and GitHub-provenance checks, and must not treat this decision as overriding any failure.

The maintainer retains the separate publication transition for lesson status, source-confidence and retained claim review-status fields; this merge decision does not authorize publication or a GitHub merge by the finalizer.
